correctness.rationale: The Hamming adjacency-distance recurrence yields explicit exact distance-1,2,3,4 coefficients of the degree-four RK4 matrix. Positivity of every diagonal follows from positive definiteness of the even-order exponential Taylor polynomial. Explicit Bernstein-basis coefficients are positive for distance-one and distance-two shells up to the distance-three horizon except d=3,q>=13; there, a unique earlier edge root exists by a one-sign-change Descartes argument. Distance-three entries become strictly negative past the universal horizon. The all-parameter certificate is displayed in RESULT.md; the extracted stdlib verifier returned 6556 exact identities and direct small-graph comparisons, with finite checks used only as corroboration.

value.rationale: The q-ary Cartesian power of complete graphs is a canonical product-diffusion model, and positivity must be controlled separately from spectral stability. The theorem determines the sharp allowable end-step for every d>=3,q>=3, identifies the exact controlling Hamming distance, and reveals the unexpected discrete transition at q=13 for d=3 only. Its algebraic positivity certificate can guide stable and nonnegative numerical heat evolution. It is neither a restatement of universal SSP theory nor an arbitrary small-parameter computation.
